sources.title: GPT-6.1 Sol - API Pricing & Benchmarks - openrouter.ai
sources.snippet: GPT-6.1 Sol is an upgrade to GPT-6 Sol from OpenAI, positioned below the flagship GPT-6 Astra in the GPT-6 series. $2 per million input tokens, $10 per million output tokens. 1,050,000 token context window, maximum output of 128,000 tokens. Higher uptime with 2 providers. Includes independent benchmarks from Artificial Analysis.
